description: Fast keyword search of the KJV (English index — phrase your query in English). Two or more words are read as a phrase first: verses with those words in that order come first, in Bible order, with `phrase_total` counting them all; then verses with every word; then related verses ranked by verse text and the site's commentary. Each verse's `match` says which (phrase, all_words, related). Returned verse text is in the user's conversation language when available, KJV otherwise. Outside trulyrandomverse.com/ai the default edition is the KJV ('english'); pass `lang` for another. Editions whose licence does not allow redistribution are refused. Book, chapter and verse are always KJV numbering, in every edition: the text returned is that edition's rendering of the same KJV verse. A few editions number some chapters differently in print (Ukrainian, Douay-Rheims, Geneva, Swedish and Serbian, mostly in Psalms), so a reader quoting their own Bible's number there may mean a neighbouring KJV verse.

lang.description: Optional. Internal language code for returned verse text. Defaults to the user's conversation language.

query.description: Keyword or short phrase in English, max 200 chars.

name: keyword_search
title: Search the KJV by keyword
